title: Graders and Sorters, Agricultural Products
description: Grade, sort, or classify unprocessed food and other agricultural products by size, weight, color, or condition.

tasks.text: Place products in containers according to grade and mark grades on containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking forestry products is manual field work

dwas.name: Mark agricultural or forestry products for identification.
Package agricultural products for shipment or further processing.

tasks.text: Weigh products or estimate their weight, visually or by feel.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on measurement of agricultural products

dwas.name: Measure physical characteristics of forestry or agricultural products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Discard inferior or defective products or foreign matter, and place acceptable products in containers for further processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Packaging agricultural products is manual handling

dwas.name: Package agricultural products for shipment or further processing.

tasks.text: Grade and sort products according to factors such as color, species, length, width, appearance, feel, smell, and quality to ensure correct processing and usage.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Agricultural material sorting is hands-on field work

tasks.text: Record grade or identification numbers on tags or on shipping, receiving, or sales sheets.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record inventory data; field collection is human

dwas.name: Record agricultural or forestry inventory data.
